newsitem.title: USA: Heartland Partners still plans distribution.
newsitem.headline: Heartland Partners still plans distribution.

text.p: Heartland Partners LP, a real estate developer, said Thursday it continues to plan a $2 per unit distribution upon completion of a second transaction in its Goose Island industrial park in Chicago.
In September, it sold 15.2 acres in Goose Island to Republic Aluminum for $4.4 million, Heartland said in its third quarter statement.

The second Goose Island transaction, a joint venture development of 10.3 acres, is expected to close in late 1996 or early 1997, Heartland said. It intends to make the distribution when the joint venture is closed and the proceeds have been received, it said.
Heartland also said it signed letters of intent for residential projects in St. Mary's, Georgia and Lake Geneva, Wisconsin.
As reported earlier, Heartland, a master limited partnership, had net income of $1.45 per Class A unit in the third quarter versus a year-ago loss of $0.22 a Class A unit.
In addition to the first Goose Island transaction, third quarter property sales also included the $400,000 sale of 0.65 acre on Chicago's North Avenue, Heartland said.
